ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottled regions on the distal halves of both lobes, containing secondary dark circular spots; a large, contiguous dark-pigmented triangular region occupies the central area from the peduncle to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch, approximately 45-50 degrees at the vertex, creating a distinct central depression between the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by varying peak amplitudes that increase in jaggedness towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular 'target' scars (dark rings with light centers) are present; specifically a pair on the mid-left lobe and several scattered on the mid-to-distal right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous fine, white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible, mostly oriented diagonally across the dark central peduncle-to-notch region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization (dense white clusters) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; various nicks and small notches along the trailing edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'double-ring' scar formation on the left lobe and a prominent vertical white scratch on the right inner lobe near the central dark zone.
